get.description: Reports the retention deadline, legal hold, lifecycle version and tombstone state, together with the reasons anonymization would be refused right now. Reading never records a policy, so looking at a principal does not start a retention clock. Blockers cover what this module decides; a module that still holds the principal's data refuses during the attempt and names itself, because that is the reason that says where the data still is.
get.summary: Read a principal's retention policy and what blocks erasing it

post.description: This cannot be undone. Every owning module erases what it holds in one transaction, and a database tombstone then refuses to let the record be restored. The principal must already be suspended, its retention deadline must have passed, no legal hold may stand, and the request must repeat the principal's current login name -- checked while the row is locked, so it cannot be satisfied by a name read before someone else renamed the principal.
post.summary: Irreversibly erase a suspended principal's personal data

put.description: The version is the policy this decision was made against, so two administrators deciding from the same screen cannot silently overwrite each other -- the second is told the policy moved. Reference is an administrative case identifier and must not repeat the subject's own data, which erasure would then be unable to remove.
put.summary: Record how long a principal's data is kept, and whether a hold prevents erasing it

delete.description: Restores the account to active without recreating credentials, because suspension keeps them. A permanently anonymized principal is refused: its row is a tombstone and the database rejects the write as well.
delete.summary: Lift a principal suspension applied from the platform

put.description: Reaches a principal that holds no membership, which the tenant suspension route cannot address and the closure route only covers after the person asks. It revokes sessions and refresh tokens and refuses to remove the last administrator of a tenant the principal still belongs to.
put.summary: Suspend a principal, including one no tenant administrator can reach
